_notes: WoundShot harness (-woundshot, WoundShot.cs). hitsPerSide hits from each side onto the other through the real hit resolver; moves[] is the order (zone: thrust torso, heavy_overhead head, light_left/right arm, kick legs); a missing move id is skipped. contactDistM = root-to-root distance of the scripted hit (steps in by contactStepM down to contactMinM when a hit does not land, up to maxRetries). waitAfterHitSec = delay between the landed hit and the two captures. minLeftFrac/healToFrac: when the next hit could take the victim under minLeftFrac of max hp, its hp is topped up to healToFrac (never to full: a full-hp fighter loses its wounds). close* = the close camera on the wound (distance in metres at victim scale 1, fov, yaw off the attacker line, size of the render texture). maxWorkingSetGB: FAIL and abort above it; sampleEverySec: working-set log interval. decalSlack: fading decals allowed above the wounds.json maxDecals cap. fadeTol: how far below the row opacity a decal fadeFactor counts as fading. requireRealFlags: FAIL when -fast is given (the real runtime_flags.json must be used). enabled=false = the flag does nothing.
_woundgate_v105: WOUNDGATE v105 gate numbers (WoundShot.cs + WoundGate.cs; nothing relaxed, only added). memProbeMinGB: the process memory probe (kernel32) must read at least this or FAIL probe dead (v103 read 0.00 GB: Process.WorkingSet64 is 0 in the Mono player). memMaxGrowthGB: FAIL + abort when the working set grows by more than this since the first sample (the 37 GB decal leak would trip this long before maxWorkingSetGB). decalTexMaxMB: generated Wound_* textures. vis*: geometry proof, the close camera orbits closeYawCandidatesDeg until a pose sees the wound; a wound is visible when visMinFrac of the visAlong sample points are inside the frame (visMargin kept free) with no collider (visEpsM) between the camera and them; visFail FAILs the close frame, visGameFail is info only (the game camera sits behind Joan, her own body hides her frontal wounds). proof*: the same close frame with the decal projector off; FAIL unless proofMinPx pixels (per-channel diff over proofChannelThr/255) change inside the projected box, the ON-vs-ON control changes under proofNoiseMaxFrac of that, and the changed pixels centre inside proofCentreMin..Max of the frame. Thresholds are first guesses: calibrate on the first v105 woundshot (the harness logs every count).
